wary.text: (The wounded Gyria watches you, one hand on a broken blade.) Keep walking, Guild-wearer. I have nothing left for you to take.

meet.text: (The wounded Gyria scout tries to stand and fails.) So. The Guild sends its best to finish a cripple. Go on, then.

choices.text: I'm not here to kill you. Why are your people raiding the March?
You're my prisoner. You'll answer to the Warden.

why.text: Raiding. Hah. Our valleys are dying — the Pale Withering, our elders call it. Grass turns to ash, beasts walk off cliffs, children sleep and don't wake. Warchief Vorga says the ring-stones can hold it back. Maybe she's right. Maybe she's mad. Either way, we followed her south.

choices.text: Go home to your people. I won't stop you.
I'm sorry. But you're coming with me.

spare.text: ...You're a strange one. Then hear this: Vorga waits at the Broken Fort, north beyond the Spire. She strikes the earth before she charges — when the ground glows, get away from her. And when she roars, she grows faster. Don't let her corner you.

detain.text: (Kesh spits, but lets you bind her hands.) The Guild's justice. We'll see what it's worth. Your Warden will find me a poor prize — Vorga is at the Broken Fort, and she won't stop for me.

spared.text: Still here, Guild-wearer? I'll leave when I can walk. Remember — when the ground glows, move.
